answer: Price each identity with a prediction market: a market opens on its honesty this season. Traders stake for or against it, and influence follows net long stake, not headcount. A violet flag appears when shorts outweigh longs, freezing its weight. Like a glacier, price moves slowly because stakes lock all season, so fakes cannot pump a rating overnight. Each identity must anchor its market to a record of past jobs for traders to verify before risking money. An attacker with a hundred fakes must outbid shorts in every market, and each exposed fake pays its shorts, so farm cost grows with size.
